[FMLA 14] DropDistance — Distance of Drop

Vertical displacement under constant g from ROM (CONST 9-3 = 9.80665).

Calculator scroll name: DropDistance. Vertical displacement under constant g from ROM (not a typed 9.8).

formula
s=v0​t+21​gt2

If you let go (no throw), v₀ is 0 and the formula collapses to s = ½ g t². Time has more effect than it first looks: double the time, four times the distance.

keys
FMLA→1→4

Primary inputs: v₁, t.

steps

How to run

  1. Press FMLA, then 1, then 4 (or scroll to the name and EXE)
  2. Enter each prompted value
  3. Read the result

Example

v₁ = 2 m/s, t = 4 s (ROM g = 9.80665)
S = 2×4 + ½×9.80665×16 = 86.4532 m
note

Uses gravitational acceleration g from ROM (not a rounded 9.8 you type yourself). v₀ in m/s, t in seconds (t > 0), s in m.
